mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing forward discount rates, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month signals weakening labor market strength, lowering consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of falling PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% signals strengthening domestic supply capacity, reducing near-term inflationary pressures and lowering discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 2% signals weakening supply-side capacity, raising inflation expectations and discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of falling INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in home sales (HOUST) exceeding 3% signals deteriorating consumer demand, compressing forward discount rates and lowering equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling HOUST are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in home sales (HOUST) above 3% signals strengthening consumer demand, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
